strategies.description: Value, momentum, quality and low-volatility are distinct long-only equity factor exposures whose realized correlations and volatilities vary through time. allowed_changes: use exact frozen VBR/MTUM/QUAL/SPLV adjusted-close total-return files
convert all four legs to CNY using the same historical usd_per_cny path before covariance estimation
at first common trading date of each calendar year compute covariance from exactly the preceding 252 common daily CNY returns, excluding execution-day prices
